column1: #Text=CVE-2021-44521: Apache Cassandra: Remote code execution for scripted UDFs
#Text=When running Apache Cassandra with the following configuration:
#Text=it is possible for an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the host.
#Text=The attacker would need to have enough permissions to create user defined functions in the cluster to be able to exploit this.
#Text=Note that this configuration is documented as unsafe, and will continue to be considered unsafe after this CVE.
#Text=This issue is being tracked as CASSANDRA-17352
#Text=This issue was discovered by Omer Kaspi of the JFrog Security vulnerability research team.
#Text=update NodeJS dependencies by handle security issues.
#Text=Many will be simple enough to fix using 'npm audit fix'.
#Text=That should be landed first and done here.
#Text=The others can be done here or spun off to separate bugs depending on amount of work.
#Text=The {{--archive-command}} parameter to {code}nodetool enable{audit,fullquery}log{code} allows an attacker to execute arbitrary commands as the user running cassandra.
#Text=Patch adds a configuration option which disallows using this parameter - for any existing users of --archive-command this can be re-enabled
#Text=User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Fedora; Linux x86_64; rv:93.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/93.0
